commit.message:
Add comprehensive RVV instruction documentation

Adds human-readable long_name and description for 21 RVV instructions:
- Memory operations: vle8.v, vle16.v, vle32.v, vle64.v, vse8.v, vse16.v, vse32.v, vse64.v
- Arithmetic operations: vadd.vv, vadd.vx, vadd.vi, vsub.vv, vsub.vx
- Logical operations: vand.vv, vor.vv, vxor.vv
- Mask operations: vmerge.vvm
- Configuration: vsetvli.yaml, vsetivli.yaml, vsetvl.yaml

All descriptions are based on the ratified RISC-V Vector Specification 1.0:
- Memory instructions: Section 7.4
- Arithmetic instructions: Section 11.1
- Logical instructions: Section 11.3
- Mask instructions: Section 15.1
- Configuration: Section 6

Reference: https://github.com/riscv/riscv-v-spec/blob/master/v-spec.adoc

Add RVV shift instruction documentation

Adds human-readable long_name and description for vector shift instructions
(vsll.vv, vsll.vx, vsll.vi, vsrl.vv, vsrl.vx, vsrl.vi, vsra.vv, vsra.vx, vsra.vi)
based on RISC-V Vector Specification 1.1 §11.6.

All descriptions include:
- Operation behavior (logical/arithmetic shift)
- Register usage (vd, vs2, vs1/rs1/imm)
- Shift amount handling (lg2(SEW) bits used)
- Masking support (vm behavior)
- Tail policy compliance

Reference: https://github.com/riscv/riscv-v-spec

Add RVV comparison instruction documentation

Adds human-readable long_name and description for vector comparison instructions
(vmseq.vv, vmseq.vx, vmseq.vi, vmsne.vv, vmsne.vx, vmsne.vi, vmsltu.vv, vmsltu.vx, vmslt.vv, vmslt.vx, vmsleu.vv, vmsleu.vx, vmsleu.vi, vmsle.vv, vmsle.vx, vmsle.vi, vmsgtu.vx, vmsgtu.vi, vmsgt.vx, vmsgt.vi) based on RISC-V Vector Specification 1.1 §11.8.

All descriptions include:
- Operation behavior (equal, not equal, less than, greater than)
- Comparison type (signed/unsigned)
- Register usage (vd, vs2, vs1/rs1/imm)
- Masking support (vm behavior)
- Tail policy compliance

Reference: https://github.com/riscv/riscv-v-spec

Add RVV floating-point instruction documentation

Adds human-readable long_name and description for vector floating-point instructions
(vfadd.vv, vfadd.vf, vfsub.vv, vfsub.vf, vfmul.vv, vfmul.vf, vfdiv.vv, vfdiv.vf)
based on RISC-V Vector Specification 1.1 §13.

All descriptions include:
- Operation behavior (add, subtract, multiply, divide)
- Register usage (vd, vs2, vs1/rs1)
- IEEE-754 floating-point standards compliance
- Masking support (vm behavior)
- Tail policy compliance

Reference: https://github.com/riscv/riscv-v-spec

Add RVV Zvbb and Zvbc instruction documentation

Adds human-readable long_name and description for 20 RVV sub-extension instructions:
- Zvbb (Vector Bit-Manipulation): 16 instructions
  * Rotate operations: vrol.vx, vrol.vv, vror.vx, vror.vv, vror.vi
  * Count operations: vctz.v, vclz.v, vcpop.v
  * Shift operations: vwsll.vv, vwsll.vx, vwsll.vi
  * Logical operations: vandn.vv, vandn.vx
  * Reverse operations: vbrev.v, vbrev8.v, vrev8.v
- Zvbc (Vector Carry-less Multiply): 4 instructions
  * vclmul.vv, vclmul.vx, vclmulh.vv, vclmulh.vx

All descriptions are based on the ratified RISC-V Vector Bit-Manipulation Specification:
- Zvbb instructions: Vector Bit-Manipulation Extension
- Zvbc instructions: Vector Carry-less Multiply Extension

Reference: https://github.com/riscv/riscv-v-spec/blob/master/v-spec.adoc

Add RVV cryptographic and floating-point extension documentation

Adds human-readable long_name and description for 23 RVV sub-extension instructions:
- Zvfbfmin (Vector BFloat16): 2 instructions
  * vfwcvtbf16.f.f.v, vfncvtbf16.f.f.w
- Zvfbfwma (Vector BFloat16 Fused Multiply-Add): 2 instructions
  * vfwmaccbf16.vf, vfwmaccbf16.vv
- Zvkg (Vector Galois Field): 2 instructions
  * vghsh.vv, vgmul.vv
- Zvkned (Vector AES): 10 instructions
  * vaeskf1.vi, vaesdm.vs, vaesem.vs, vaeskf2.vi, vaesdf.vs, vaesef.vs, vaesdm.vv, vaesem.vv, vaesdf.vv, vaesef.vv
- Zvknha (Vector SHA-2): 3 instructions
  * vsha2ch.vv, vsha2ms.vv, vsha2cl.vv
- Zvks (Vector SM3/SM4): 5 instructions
  * vsm3me.vv, vsm3c.vi, vsm4k.vi, vsm4r.vs, vsm4r.vv

All descriptions are based on the ratified RISC-V Vector Cryptographic and Floating-Point Extensions:
- Zvfbfmin/Zvfbfwma: Vector BFloat16 Floating-Point Specification
- Zvkg: Vector Galois Field Cryptographic Extension
- Zvkned: Vector AES Cryptographic Extension
- Zvknha: Vector SHA-2 Cryptographic Extension
- Zvks: Vector Chinese Cryptographic Extension (SM3/SM4)

Reference: https://github.com/riscv/riscv-v-spec/blob/master/v-spec.adoc
